source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 16-17 (IRP3(c): employees tax to be deducted at a fixed amount; the Commissioner may direct the employer to "deduct a specified amount of employees tax")
notes: R30 000 salary, an IRP3(c) directive for a fixed R2 500 a month: PAYE = R2 500.00 whatever the tables say (G21 p. 16-17: "employers may under no circumstances deviate from the instructions of the directive", p. 15). The tables give 4 681.00. SDL 300.00 (1% of R30 000); UIF 177.12 (ceiling); net 30 000 - 2 500 - 177.12 = 27 322.88. NAMED LIMIT: G21 does not say whether the fixed amount is per payment or per tax year; it is read as per monthly payment: MEDIUM confidence.
